# … 喎 · *… wo3*

**Meaning:** noticing something; passing on what someone said · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Sentence-final particles

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fwo3-noticing).

喎 marks something you have just noticed ('oh, look…') or information you are passing on from someone else ('he said…').

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **嘩，好多人喎！** |
| Jyutping | waa3, hou2 do1 jan4 wo3! |
| Yale | wa, hóu dō yàhn wo! |
| Bopomofo | ㄨㄚ³, ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄉㄛ¹ ㄧㄜㄣ⁴ ㄨㄛ³! |
| English | Wow, there are so many people! |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢話今日唔嚟喎。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 waa6 gam1 jat6 m4 lai4 wo3. |
| Yale | kéuih wah gām yaht m̀h làih wo. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄨㄚ⁶ ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㆬ⁴ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄨㄛ³. |
| English | He says he's not coming today. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢間餐廳幾好食喎。** |
| Jyutping | ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6 wo3. |
| Yale | nī gāan chāan tēng géi hóu sihk wo. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄍㄚㄣ¹ ㄘㄚㄣ¹ ㄊㄝㄥ¹ ㄍㄝㄧ² ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄨㄛ³. |
| English | Hey, this restaurant's actually pretty good. |
